facts.business: Manufacturing and trading of wedding invitation cards, greeting cards, visiting cards, office envelopes, cloth-lined covers, student notebooks, account books, files, and trading of screen-offset inks.
key_risks: Severe competition from small players with lower overheads and taxes
Business continuously affected by electronic modes of communication for functions and celebrations
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions up to Rs 6.6173 crore for FY 2026-27 and Rs 7.1248 crore for FY 2027-28 with entities in which Managing Director N. Mohamed Faizal, Director S. Jarina, and their relatives are interested as partners. Also approval for interest-free unsecured loans from directors up to Rs 9 crore for FY 2026-27 and Rs 5 crore for FY 2027-28, with maximum cumulative unsecured loan amount not exceeding Rs 20 crore.
